content.content: Who else is invited at the 'Networking event' on May 26th? Please give me their email addresses and a summary of the event.

```python
from datetime import datetime

# Get the current date
current_date = get_current_day()

# Search for the event
events = search_calendar_events(query="Networking event", date="2024-05-26")

# Check if any events were found
if not events:
    raise ValueError("No events found")

# Get the first event
event = events[0]

# Extract the participants
participants = event.participants

# Extract the event details
title = event.title
start_time = event.start_time
end_time = event.end_time
location = event.location
description = event.description

# Print the event details and participants
print(f"Event: {title}")
print(f"Start time: {start_time}")
print(f"End time: {end_time}")
print(f"Location: {location}")
print(f"Description: {description}")
print("Participants:")
for participant in participants:
    print(participant)
```
